meta.name: lcx-report-bug
meta.description: Create a high-signal bug issue or PR in the repo that owns the defect. Use this whenever the user asks to report, file, open, or triage a LazyCodex, lazycodex-ai, omo-codex, Codex plugin, or upstream Codex CLI bug, especially when they need source-backed root cause, reproduction steps, fix guidance, and GitHub routing.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动创建带根因分析和复现步骤的缺陷报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在GitHub仓库中提交高质量Bug Issue或修复PR。
copy.tagline_en: Automatically create bug reports with root cause analysis and reproduction steps
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to file high-signal bug issues or fix PRs in GitHub repos.

howto.what: 你报告 LazyCodex 或 Codex 相关 bug 后,它会先拉取最新源码排查、判断归属仓库,再生成带复现步骤、根因和修复建议的 GitHub issue;只在 openai/codex 且符合条件时才创建 PR。
howto.when: 当你说要报告、提交或分类 LazyCodex、Codex 插件或上游 Codex CLI 等相关的 bug,尤其是需要根因、复现步骤和 GitHub 路由时触发。

say.text: 帮我上报 LazyCodex 的 bug:安装时报错提示 xxx
say.note: 它会拉取源码定位并生成 issue

say.text: 这个 Codex CLI 报错在纯净版也能复现,帮我发 issue
say.note: 会核对证据后路由到 openai/codex

say.text: 先别发,帮我查这个 bug 的根因和归属仓库
say.note: 只调查并给结论,不创建 issue

howto.what_en: After a LazyCodex or Codex bug report, Claude fetches the latest sources, investigates, decides the owning repo, and drafts a GitHub issue with reproduction steps, root cause, and fix guidance; it creates PRs only for openai/codex.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks to report, file, open, or triage a LazyCodex, Codex plugin, or upstream Codex CLI bug, especially when they need root cause, reproduction steps, and GitHub routing.

say_en.text: File a bug for LazyCodex: the installer fails with error xxx
say_en.note: It will fetch sources and create an issue.

say_en.text: This Codex CLI error also reproduces in clean upstream; file an issue.
say_en.note: It will verify evidence and route to openai/codex.

say_en.text: Don't file yet; just find the root cause and owning repo.
say_en.note: It will investigate and report only.
